messages:
Marta Silva: quick onboarding q 1: where do people put private ramp notes vs the canonical playbook pages? also who owns the onboarding templates so I can get edit rights?
Riley Chen: hey Marta, private = My Workspace (Notion). Canonical playbooks live under Knowledge Base > Teams > Product (we try to avoid editing source pages directly). Templates are in Knowledge Base > Templates > New Hire Toolkit. Owner is shown under the template header (Owner: Team Docs or person).
Ola Martins: quick pattern: duplicate the template into your workspace, rename (e.g., 'Marta 1: 30/60/90') and share with your manager. If you need to change the canonical template, request via docops so we have an audit trail.
Marta Silva: is there a fast route to request doc edit instead of the long form?
DocOps: Use the quick Slack snippet to create a ticket: `/doc-access-request --page "https://notion.redwood.company/KnowledgeBase/Templates/NewHire/Onboarding-Checklist" --reason "customize for product role" --assign TeamDocs`
Riley Chen: that creates DOCS-9004 and pings the rotation. If urgent, ping @TeamDocs in the page comments and mention the ticket.
Marta Silva: perfect, did that. one last: any recommended 1:1 template that managers prefer?
Ola Martins: we use Templates > New Hire Toolkit > "Manager 1:1 Agenda" and "New Hire Goals (30/60/90)". They include check-ins aligned to onboarding milestones. Duplicate and keep the source link at the top so maintainers know it's derived. :sparkles:
